lines.en: label nikidate1:
I tap on Niki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Niki 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: I feel like I’m supposed to be a little nervous about doing this considering she is my apparent ex-girlfriend as well as a pop star, but-
lines.zh: 考虑到她既是我所谓的前女友、又是个流行歌手，我觉得自己多少该有点紧张才对，不过——

lines.en: Eh.
lines.zh: 呃。

lines.en: It just feels like any other phone call to me.
lines.zh: 对我来说，这跟平时打的任何一通电话没什么两样。

lines.en: And if this call is going to be anything like our “first” meeting the other day, I imagine she’s just going to yell at me or something like that.
lines.zh: 而如果这通电话跟我们前几天那次“初次”见面差不多的话，我猜她大概又会冲我吼什么的。

lines.en: But hey, if we’re ever going to patch things up (And start having sex again), I’ve gotta start somewhere.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，如果我们真想修补关系（并且重新开始上床），总得有个开头。

lines.en: : Thank you for calling 567 Productions. How can I help you?
lines.zh: : 感谢致电 567 Productions。请问有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: : Hello?
: I’d like to speak with Niki Nakayama, please.
lines.zh: : 我想找中山 Niki，谢谢。

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : But I’m her ex.
lines.zh: : 可我是她前男友。

lines.en: : That’s even worse.
lines.zh: : 那就更不行了。

lines.en: : Please do not call here anymore.
lines.zh: : 请您不要再打来了。

lines.en: : Wait, I think you’re misunderstanding something.
lines.zh: : 等等，我想你是误会了什么。

lines.en: : She’s the one who gave me this number.
lines.zh: : 是这个号码她给我的。

lines.en: : Then she clearly doesn’t want to talk with you.
lines.zh: : 那她显然是不想跟你说话。

lines.en: : You are aware that she has her own phone, correct?
lines.zh: : 您知道她自己有手机，对吧？

lines.en: That fucking bitch.
lines.zh: 那个婊子。

lines.en: : Listen...is she around? Just tell her I’m calling and if she doesn’t want to take it then...hang up on me or something.
lines.zh: : 听着……她在吗？你就跟她说我在找她，要是她不想接，那就……直接挂我电话什么的。

lines.en: : ...Okay, fine.
lines.zh: : ……好吧，行吧。

lines.en: : Can I have your name?
lines.zh: : 请问您贵姓？

lines.en: : It’s...uhh...
menu:
Noodles
lines.zh: 面条

lines.en: $ nikitemp = "Noodles"
: My name is Noodles.
lines.zh: : 我叫面条。

lines.en: : Noodles the Bird.
lines.zh: : 面条鸟。

lines.en: : Your name is not Noodles the Bird.
lines.zh: : 你的名字不叫面条鸟。

lines.en: : Tell her my name is Noodles the Bird.
lines.zh: : 就跟她说我叫面条鸟。

lines.en: : Is this some sort of inside joke between the two of you?
lines.zh: : 这是你们俩之间的什么内部玩笑吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Now, tell her.
lines.zh: : 是的。现在，去跟她说。

lines.en: : Okay...fine.
lines.zh: : 好……好吧。

lines.en: : Please hold.
lines.zh: : 请稍等。

lines.en: Paul
lines.zh: 保罗

lines.en: $ nikitemp = "Paul"
: My name is Paul.
lines.zh: : 我叫保罗。

lines.en: : An American? How come I never heard of this?
lines.zh: : 美国人？我怎么从来没听说过？

lines.en: : How long ago were the two of you together?
lines.zh: : 你们两个在一起是多久以前的事了？

lines.en: : Please stop prying into my personal life. This is between Niki and me.
lines.zh: : 请不要再打探我的私事了。这是我和 Niki 之间的事。

lines.en: : Apologies, Paul. I’ll let her know you’re calling right away.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，保罗。我马上帮您转达。

lines.en: Barack Obama, 44th President of the United States
lines.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马，美利坚合众国第 44 任总统

lines.en: $ nikitemp = "Barack"
: I’m Barack Obama, 44th president of the United States of America.
lines.zh: : 我是巴拉克·奥巴马，美利坚合众国第 44 任总统。

lines.en: : I don’t have all day. I have meetings to attend.
lines.zh: : 我可没一整天的时间。我还有会要开。

lines.en: : Please hold for one moment...
lines.zh: : 请稍等一下……

lines.en: I’m placed on hold for several minutes while the receptionist or manager or whoever it was that I was just speaking with tries to find Niki.
lines.zh: 我被晾着等了好几分钟，前台也好、经纪人也罢——反正刚才跟我说话的那位——正设法去找 Niki。

lines.en: Hopefully, the original Sensei also had an amazing sense of humor that she will be able to quickly identify immediately upon hearing that she’s received a call.
lines.zh: 但愿原来那位 Sensei 也有同样出色的幽默感，好让她一听说有人找她，就能立刻反应过来。

lines.en: But, more than likely, I just expect to get yelled at again.
lines.zh: 不过更大的可能性是，我又得挨一顿吼。

lines.en: : Well good morning, {i}[nikitemp]{/i}...
lines.zh: : 哎呀，早上好啊，{i}[nikitemp]{/i}……

lines.en: : Hey. So nice of you to pick up.
lines.zh: : 嘿。你居然肯接，真给面子。

lines.en: : Why did you give me a fake number?
lines.zh: : 你为什么给我一个假号码？

lines.en: : It’s not fake, asshole. It’s the number to my agency.
lines.zh: : 那不是假的，混蛋。那是我事务所的电话。

lines.en: : You were just on the phone with my manager.
lines.zh: : 你刚才是跟我经纪人在讲话。

lines.en: : Also, why wouldn’t you use your normal fucking name?
lines.zh: : 还有，你为什么不用你他妈正常名字？

lines.en: : I can’t remember my normal name.
lines.zh: : 我想不起我正常叫什么了。

lines.en: : {i}Hah{/i}...amnesia card again?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}又拿失忆当挡箭牌？

lines.en: : You know me so well.
lines.zh: : 你真懂我。

lines.en: : Almost well enough to give me your normal phone number.
lines.zh: : 懂到差不多可以把你正常的电话号码给我了。

lines.en: : Oh my fucking God, shut up. Why are you even calling?
lines.zh: : 我操，闭嘴吧。你到底打电话来干嘛？

lines.en: : I’m not sure if you’ve realized, but I’m extremely busy right now and-
lines.zh: : 我不知道你有没有意识到，我现在忙得要死，而且——

lines.en: : Let’s go out to breakfast.
lines.zh: : 我们出去吃早餐吧。

lines.en: : At least let me finish my sentence, dick!
lines.zh: : 至少让我把话说完，鸡巴！

lines.en: : It’s not Dick, it’s {i}[nikitemp]{/i}.
lines.zh: : 不是鸡巴，是 {i}[nikitemp]{/i}。

lines.en: : You’re not funny.
lines.zh: : 你一点都不好笑。

lines.en: : So, are you able to sneak away for a while and catch up?
lines.zh: : 那么，你能不能偷偷溜出来一会儿，我们叙叙旧？

lines.en: : Can I choose where we go?
lines.zh: : 地点我能挑吗？

lines.en: : If that’s what makes you happy.
lines.zh: : 只要你高兴就行。

lines.en: : Fine. But {i}only{/i} for a little while. I have a class today.
lines.zh: : 好吧。但{i}只{/i}能待一小会儿。我今天还有课。

lines.en: scene black
The two of us talk for another minute or two and Niki winds up giving me an address to a diner somewhere in the middle of the city.
lines.zh: 我们又聊了一两分钟，最后 Niki 给了我一个地址，是市中心某处的一家餐厅。

lines.en: I didn’t really plan on going that far out today, but I guess you need to make certain sacrifices if you’re going to date someone famous.
lines.zh: 我今天本来没打算跑那么远，不过我想，要和名人交往，总得做出某些牺牲。

lines.en: Or at least, {i}go{/i} on a date with someone famous.
lines.zh: 或者至少，和名人{i}约一次会{/i}。

lines.en: I doubt Niki would ever want to see me again after I apparently abandoned her for years.
lines.zh: 我怀疑，在我显然抛下她那么多年之后，Niki 大概再也不想见我了。

lines.en: But hey, she’s also apparently been waiting around for closure or something, so...
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，她显然也一直在等着要个了断之类的，所以……

lines.en: I guess we’ll just have to see how things go.
lines.zh: 我想，事情会怎么发展，只能走着瞧了。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate1
: What the fuck are you wearing?
lines.zh: : 你他妈穿的这是什么玩意儿？

lines.en: : I’m a big fucking deal, {i}[nikitemp]{/i}. I need to wear this so people don’t recognize me.
lines.zh: : 我可是个大人物，{i}[nikitemp]{/i}。我得穿成这样，别人才认不出我。

lines.en: : How are you going to eat with that on?
lines.zh: : 那你戴着这个怎么吃东西？

lines.en: : I’m obviously going to take it off to eat! Have you never been on a date with an idol before?!
lines.zh: : 我当然是摘下来吃啊！你以前没跟偶像约过会吗？！

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate2
: Oh, what am I saying? Of course you haven’t. Sorry. Sometimes, I just forget how-
lines.zh: : 哦，我在说什么呢。你当然没有。抱歉。有时候我就是会忘记你有多——

lines.en: : So what do you want to eat?
lines.zh: : 那你想吃什么？

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate3
: STOP INTERRUPTING ME!
lines.zh: : 别打断我！

lines.en: : Take the disguise off, then. I want to actually talk to {i}you{/i}, not a mask and a cheap pair of sunglasses.
lines.zh: : 那就把伪装摘了。我想跟{i}你{/i}好好说话，不是跟一个口罩和一副便宜墨镜说话。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate4
: Cheap?! Those cost me a fucking fortune!
lines.zh: : 便宜？！那玩意儿花了我一大笔钱！

lines.en: : Well...I actually got them for free as a gift from the agency. But they cost {i}someone{/i} a fortune!
lines.zh: : 嗯……其实那是事务所送我的礼物，没花钱。但它确实花了别{i}人{/i}一大笔钱！

lines.en: Niki takes off her mask and her glasses and stuffs them into an oversized bag she placed beside her when she arrived.
lines.zh: Niki 摘下口罩和眼镜，塞进她进门时放在身边的那只超大号包里。

lines.en: The two of us got here around the same time, so there was no awkward waiting at the table or anything like that beforehand.
lines.zh: 我们两个差不多是同时到的，所以之前并没有在桌边尴尬地干等之类的环节。

lines.en: Just...two people who used to have sex (Probably) out for breakfast at a diner that totally isn’t something out of a popular first person shooter game.
lines.zh: 只是……两个（大概）曾经上过床的人，出来在一家绝对不是某款热门第一人称射击游戏里的餐厅吃早餐。

lines.en: : There. You look so much prettier now.
lines.zh: : 好了。你现在看起来漂亮多了。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate5
: Shut up...
lines.zh: : 闭嘴……

lines.en: : You...
: You don’t look half bad yourself.
lines.zh: : 你自己看着也不差。

lines.en: : I kind of expected you to be huge and fat and all scraggly or something by now.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你到这会儿已经又高又胖、邋里邋遢什么的了。

lines.en: : But I guess you’ve been doing alright the last few years.
lines.zh: : 不过看来这几年你过得还不错。

lines.en: : Even if you managed to make it through them without turning your fucking TV on even {i}once{/i}.
lines.zh: : 哪怕你愣是熬过了这么些年，连{i}一次{/i}他妈的电视都没打开过。

lines.en: : I’ve definitely turned the TV on. I just haven’t seen you.
lines.zh: : 我当然打开过电视。只是没看到你而已。

lines.en: : Maybe you’re just not as famous as you think you are?
lines.zh: : 也许你只是没你自以为的那么红？

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate6
: Want to bet on that?
lines.zh: : 要不要打个赌？

lines.en: : I can {i}guarantee{/i} you that our waitress will recognize me right away.
lines.zh: : 我敢{i}打包票{/i}，我们的服务员一眼就能认出我来。

lines.en: : That’s not fair. You chose this place. For all I know, you could be a regular here.
lines.zh: : 这不公平。这地方是你挑的。说不定你就是这儿的常客呢。

lines.en: : I just wanted to choose some place that no one would ever expect me to come to.
lines.zh: : 我只是想挑一个谁都想不到我会来的地方。

lines.en: : Which is exactly why I’m expecting our waitress to fall flat on her face the second she realizes she’s serving a pop star.
lines.zh: : 所以我才期待我们那位服务员一意识到自己在招待一位流行歌手，就会当场脸朝下摔个狗吃屎。

lines.en: : You’re even more of an egomaniac than I am and I’m one of the last remaining males in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 你比我还要自恋，而我可是 Kumon-mi 仅存的几个男性之一。

lines.en: : I {i}worked{/i} for this ego, {i}[nikitemp]{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我这自恋是{i}挣来的{/i}，{i}[nikitemp]{/i}。

lines.en: : But of course you’re still pretending to have amnesia so you don’t have to remember how self-conscious I always was when we were younger.
lines.zh: : 你当然还在装失忆，这样你就不用记得我们年轻的时候我有多自卑了。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate7
: Oh, perfect! Here comes our waitress now.
lines.zh: : 哦，正好！我们的服务员来了。

lines.en: : Watch and prepare to be amazed by my popularity.
lines.zh: : 看好了，准备被我的人气震惊吧。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate8
: Hi there! I’m sooo sorry for showing up unannounced. I hope I didn’t attract any paparazzi-
lines.zh: : 您好！非常抱歉我不请自来。希望我没有引来什么狗仔——

lines.en: : Friendburger Man!
lines.zh: : 朋友汉堡侠！

lines.en: : I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate9
: Hello! I am Kaori! But you may call me the Queen of Spiders or the Mistress of the Dark if you’d like.
lines.zh: : 你好！我是 Kaori！不过您也可以叫我蜘蛛女王，或者黑暗女主人，随您喜欢。

lines.en: : Are you on a date with my Friendburger?
lines.zh: : 你在和我的朋友汉堡约会吗？

lines.en: : This is actually my ex-girlfriend, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 这位其实是我前女友，Kaori。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate10
: Girlfriendburger?!
lines.zh: : 女朋友汉堡？！

lines.en: : You...
: You really don’t recognize me?
lines.zh: : 你真不认识我？

lines.en: : Niki Nakayama? Household name?
lines.zh: : 中山 Niki？家喻户晓的名字？

lines.en: : I’m on billboards and...
lines.zh: : 我上过广告牌，还有……

lines.en: : You mated with this creature?!
lines.zh: : 你和这只生物交配过？！

lines.en: : I’ll let her answer that question. I don’t think I’m at liberty to discuss my previous...{i}encounters{/i} with a celebrity.
lines.zh: : 这个问题我让她来回答。我想我没有资格讨论我以前和一位名人的那些……{i}往来{/i}。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate11
: You are a celebrity?
lines.zh: : 你是名人？

lines.en: : I apologize for not recognizing you, but I do not know many of the popular cultures.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉我没认出您，但我不太了解那些流行的文化。

lines.en: : You don’t...have to apologize. I’m just a little taken aback.
lines.zh: : 你……不用道歉。我只是有点措手不及。

lines.en: : Normally people have all sorts of questions for me when we first meet, so...this is actually a pleasant surprise, I guess?
lines.zh: : 通常别人第一次见我都会有一大堆问题，所以……这其实算是个惊喜吧，我想？

lines.en: : I have two questions for you, actually.
lines.zh: : 我有两个问题想问你。

lines.en: : Number one-
lines.zh: : 第一个——

lines.en: : Is your hair made of cotton candy?
lines.zh: : 你的头发是棉花糖做的吗？

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : Number two-
lines.zh: : 第二个——

lines.en: : Can you describe to me how much you enjoyed mating with this man?
lines.zh: : 你能不能给我详细描述一下，你和这个男人交配时有多享受？

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate12
: Kaori, are you...curious about mating?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你是……对交配感到好奇？

lines.en: : I am curious about many things. But this is the first female I have encountered with actual experience.
lines.zh: : 我对很多事情都好奇。但这是第一个我遇到的、真正有经验的女性。

lines.en: : Let alone experience with my friend! I must know!
lines.zh: : 更何况还是和我朋友有过经验的！我必须知道！

lines.en: : Describe to me in vivid detail the things you experienced, Cotton Candy Girl!
lines.zh: : 给我生动详细地描述一下你经历过的事，棉花糖女孩！

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate13
: Was this all just some ploy to get me on one of those candid reaction shows?
lines.zh: : 这一切该不会是为了把我弄上什么整人反应节目吧？

lines.en: : There’s no way any of this is actually happening, right?
lines.zh: : 这种事不可能真的在发生，对吧？

lines.en: : You get used to it after a while.
lines.zh: : 习惯了就好。

lines.en: : I found myself thinking something similar the first few times I encountered Kaori.
lines.zh: : 我头几次遇到 Kaori 的时候，也是这么想的。

lines.en: : Did she like...hit her head a little too hard?
lines.zh: : 她是不是……脑袋撞得有点太狠了？

lines.en: : There is a high likelihood of that, yes.
lines.zh: : 这个可能性相当高，是的。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate14
: Listen...Kaori, was it?
lines.zh: : 听着……你叫 Kaori，是吧？

lines.en: : I think your curiosity is quite charming, I really do.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你的好奇心挺可爱的，真的。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate15
: But if you ask either one of us about our {i}personal{/i} affairs again, I will not hesitate to destroy you.
lines.zh: : 但如果你再问我们两个任何关于{i}私生活{/i}的事，我会毫不犹豫地毁掉你。

lines.en: : Now, please make yourself useful and take our orders.
lines.zh: : 现在，请你发挥点用处，把我们点的单记一下。

lines.en: : I can not do that, Cotton Candy Girl!
lines.zh: : 我做不到，棉花糖女孩！

lines.en: : I will remain quiet about your mating rituals, but this restaurant only serves one thing! Taking your order would be a waste of time!
lines.zh: : 我可以对你交配的仪式保持沉默，但我们这家餐厅只供应一样东西！记你们的单根本是浪费时间！

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate16
: Friend. Your taste in women is very different from your taste in students.
lines.zh: : 朋友。你在女人方面的品味，和你在学生方面的品味大不相同。

lines.en: : I had no idea you were the type who enjoyed being bossed around.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道你原来是喜欢被人呼来喝去的类型。

lines.en: : I shall add this to my friendship journal. Entry number #387.
lines.zh: : 我要把这条记进我的友谊日记。第 #387 条。

lines.en: : It was a long time ago. I think my tastes may have been a little different back then.
lines.zh: : 那是很久以前的事了。我觉得那时候我的品味可能跟现在不太一样。

lines.en: : Whatever the case, Cotton Candy Girl has expressed her hunger and so I must do my duty as the number one waitress in Kumon-mi to please her.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，棉花糖女孩已经表达了她的饥饿，所以我必须尽到 Kumon-mi 头号服务员的职责，让她满意。

lines.en: : You can continue to please her in ways that I am not allowed to talk about.
lines.zh: : 至于那些我不被允许谈论的方式，你可以继续去让她满意。

lines.en: : Until we meet again in several minutes.
lines.zh: : 几分钟后再见。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate17
Kaori darts away from the table and the atmosphere between Niki and I suddenly grows even more...uncomfortable.
lines.zh: Kaori 一溜烟从桌边跑开，而我和 Niki 之间的气氛突然变得更……不自在了。

lines.en: For her, at least.
lines.zh: 至少对她来说是这样。

lines.en: I think this is the closest I’ve come to having fun in quite some time.
lines.zh: 我觉得这是我很长一段时间以来最接近“开心”的一次了。

lines.en: : Ahem...
scene nikifrtsdate18
: I know it’s been a long time since the two of us have hung out like this.
lines.zh: : 我知道我们两个像这样出来玩，已经是很久以前的事了。

lines.en: : I feel a “but” coming.
lines.zh: : 我感觉到一个“但是”要来了。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate19
: {i}But{/i} would you mind explaining to me exactly {i}how{/i} you know that girl and why she is so interested in us {i}mating{/i}?
lines.zh: : {i}但{/i}你介不介意跟我解释一下，你到底是{i}怎么{/i}认识那个女孩的，还有她为什么对我们{i}交配{/i}这么感兴趣？

lines.en: : Explain Kaori? You’ve got a lot to learn.
lines.zh: : 解释 Kaori？你要学的还多着呢。

lines.en: : That’s just not possible.
lines.zh: : 那根本不可能。

lines.en: : You are aware that even being {i}seen{/i} in public with a man could destroy my reputation, correct?
lines.zh: : 你知道光是{i}被拍到{/i}和一个男人公开出现在同一场合，就足以毁掉我的名声，对吧？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea what would happen to me if someone overheard that conversation?
lines.zh: : 你知道要是有人听到了刚才那番对话，我会怎么样吗？

lines.en: : I can’t imagine it would be anything good.
lines.zh: : 我想不会是什么好事。

lines.en: : It would make the last several years of my life meaningless.
lines.zh: : 那会让我这好几年的人生变得毫无意义。

lines.en: : The idol world is cutthroat. One wrong move and you’re done for good.
lines.zh: : 偶像界是刀口舔血的地方。一步走错，就彻底完了。

lines.en: : So if we’re going to continue going out together, {i}please{/i} make sure that nothing like that ever happens again.
lines.zh: : 所以如果我们还要继续一起出门，{i}请{/i}你保证那种事再也不会发生。

lines.en: : I think you just accidentally admitted that you want to keep seeing me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你刚刚不小心承认了自己还想继续见我。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate20
: Of course I do...
lines.zh: : 我当然想……

lines.en: : Not as a couple or anything...you ruined that.
lines.zh: : 不是作为情侣什么的……那个被你毁了。

lines.en: : But I’d be...really hurt or whatever if we didn’t at least keep in touch.
lines.zh: : 但如果我们连联系都不再联系，我会……挺受伤的，大概吧。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate21
: Oh! And you owe me an apology! A real one!
lines.zh: : 哦！还有，你欠我一个道歉！一个真正的道歉！

lines.en: : It’s not fair that you get to just walk back into my life and start talking about mating and...giving yourself weird names!
lines.zh: : 你怎么能就这么大摇大摆地走回我的人生，然后开始聊什么交配……还给自己起些奇怪的名字！

lines.en: : We’re not teenagers anymore. We are grown adults and should be acting like that.
lines.zh: : 我们已经不是青少年了。我们是成年人，就该有成年人的样子。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate22
: It doesn’t have to be today since...I know you’re still trying to come up with a better explanation than this whole “amnesia” thing, but...
lines.zh: : 不一定要今天说，因为……我知道你还在努力想一个比“失忆”更好的解释，不过……

lines.en: : Whenever you’re ready to actually {i}talk{/i}...that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 等你哪天真的准备好要{i}谈{/i}了……那就好。

lines.en: : We can just keep going out to breakfast or something until then.
lines.zh: : 在那之前，我们可以就这么一直出来吃早餐什么的。

lines.en: : And if I have no idea how long that will take?
lines.zh: : 要是我根本不知道那要花多久呢？

lines.en: : Then you’re going to be buying me a lot of breakfasts.
lines.zh: : 那你就得请我吃很多很多顿早餐。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate23
: I present to you, the Route 69 Diner’s special {i}and only{/i} item, the sausage-fest!
lines.zh: : 为您呈上，69 号公路餐厅{i}唯一{/i}也是招牌的一道菜，香肠盛宴！

lines.en: : Wha-
: People actually...{i}eat{/i} this?
lines.zh: : 真的有人……{i}吃{/i}这个？

lines.en: : Friend. Your ex-girlfriend does not seem to grasp the concept of food.
lines.zh: : 朋友。你前女友似乎不理解食物的概念。

lines.en: : Is this what ended your previous relationship?
lines.zh: : 这就是你们上一段关系结束的原因吗？

lines.en: : Yes. This is exactly why we broke up.
lines.zh: : 对。我们就是因为这个分手的。

lines.en: : Niki, enjoy the sausage-fest.
lines.zh: : Niki，好好享用你的香肠盛宴吧。

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate24
: Actually, I already ate breakfast this morning. And that’s way too much food.
lines.zh: : 其实，我今天早上已经吃过早餐了。而且这也太多了。

lines.en: : This is all you.
lines.zh: : 这些都归你了。

lines.en: : Kaori, are you hungry?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你饿吗？

lines.en: : Wieners make my mouth feel funny. I think they are too big for me.
lines.zh: : 香肠会让我的嘴巴有种奇怪的感觉。我觉得它们对我来说太大了。

lines.en: : Can you say that one more time but a little slower?
lines.zh: : 你能不能再慢慢说一遍？

lines.en: I take out my phone to record and-
lines.zh: 我掏出手机准备录下来，然后——

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate25
: Stop hitting on the fucking waitress right in front of me!
lines.zh: : 别他妈当着我的面勾搭服务员！

lines.en: : Enjoy your wieners! I must help another customer now!
lines.zh: : 好好享用你们的香肠吧！我现在得去招呼别的客人了！

lines.en: : Let us hang the outs again soon, Friend! John misses you!
lines.zh: : 朋友，我们改天再一起出去玩吧！John 想你了！

lines.en: : Sounds good, Kaori. Thanks for your service.
lines.zh: : 好啊，Kaori。谢谢你的服务。

lines.en: : Of course! Please remember to like, comment and subscribe!
lines.zh: : 当然！请记得点赞、评论加订阅！

lines.en: scene nikifrtsdate26
: Really, though. I’m not hungry at all. I can’t eat that.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的。我一点都不饿。我吃不下那个。

lines.en: I take one last look at the colossal pile of food before me...
lines.zh: 我最后看了一眼面前那堆堆积如山的食物……

lines.en: And surrender myself to the sausage-fest.
lines.zh: 然后向香肠盛宴投降。

lines.en: scene black
Of course, I’m barely able to finish any of it.
lines.zh: 当然，我几乎没吃完多少。

lines.en: And apparently this diner doesn’t offer to-go boxes either, so a good thirty pounds of food are left on the table by the time we leave.
lines.zh: 而且这家餐厅居然连打包盒都不提供，所以我们走的时候，桌上还剩了足足三十磅的食物。

lines.en: But at least Niki and I got to “reconnect” a bit.
lines.zh: 不过至少，我和 Niki 算是“重新连接”了一下。

lines.en: She’s not much different from how I pictured her after our first meeting in the studio, but...
lines.zh: 她和我在录音棚第一次见面之后想象的她没什么两样，不过……

lines.en: I guess I can see why the old Sensei might have fallen for her.
lines.zh: 我想，我能理解原来的 Sensei 为什么会爱上她。

lines.en: {i}Congratulations! You now have Niki’s real phone number and don’t have to lie about your name anymore!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你现在有 Niki 的真实号码了，以后不用再谎报名字了！{/i}

lines.en: $ niki_love += 1
$ nikidate1 = True
{i}Niki’s affection has increased to [niki_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Niki 的好感度提升到了 [niki_love]!{/i}
